Sin Wen Evening News dated May 30 :-

ANNIVERSARY OF MAY 30TH INCIDENT

At 10 a.m. today, the 9th anniversary of the
May 30th Tragedy, a public sacrifice was offered at the
May 30th Martyrs Cemetery, Fang Ka Moh Road (方家木桥),
North Pao Shing Road, Chapei. Some 50 persons including
Yu Ya Ching, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the May 30th
Martyrs Cemetery, Wong Shi'o Lai, Wong Hon Liang and represent-
atives from the 1st Special District Citizens Federation
were present. Speeches bearing on the occasion were given.
When interviewed by a reporter of the Sin Sun
News Agency, a responsible person of the Board of Directors
of the May 30th Martyrs Cemetery stated a primary school
would be established on the vacant ground in the cemetery.
The work will be completed in five or six months.
No holiday was observed by various organs and
schools in this locality. Flags were flown at half-mast.
At 2 p.m. a drama entitled the "May 30th Blood"
was performed by members of the People's Educational
Institution at the premises on Wen Miao Road, West Gate.
Precautionary measures were adopted in Chinese
controlled territory and both the Settlements, and suspects
were searched.

Reg.档案 to file.

1934年5月31日

5月30日的《新闻晚报》：

五卅惨案周年纪念

今日上午10时，正值五卅惨案九周年纪念日，在闸北宝兴北路方家木桥路的五卅烈士公墓举行了公祭。出席者包括五卅烈士公墓董事会主席俞雅清（Yu Ya Ching）、Wong Shi'o Lai、Wong Hon Liang 以及第一特区市民联合会代表等约50人。会上发表了与 occasion 相关的演讲。
在接受《新声通讯社》记者采访时，五卅烈士公墓董事会的一位负责人表示，将在公墓内的空地上建立一所小学。工程将在五六个月内完工。
本地各机关和学校均未放假。旗帜降半旗致哀。
下午2时，民众教育馆成员在西门文庙路址上演了名为《五卅血》的话剧。
在华界及两租界均采取了预防措施，并对嫌疑人进行了搜查。

登记归档。

May 31, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

The New China (新中華), a mosquito paper, publishes the
following article on May 30, 1934.

ANNIVERSARY OF MAY 30TH TRAGEDY

To-day is the Anniversary of May 30th Tragedy.
Everybody knows that the Tragedy occurred as a result of
the oppression of imperialists in the International
Settlement of Shanghai, but the principal cause was the
shooting of our labourers by Japanese imperialists.
A number of years have elapsed since the Tragedy
occurred. The blood stains of the martyrs on Nanking
Road have already gone and the people have become
oblivious of the Tragedy. But the imperialists in
China have become stronger and stronger. The Mukden
Incident of September 18th and the January 28th Event
have followed to cause sorrow to the people. No more
slogans of "down with imperialism" have been heard.
Is this the reason why national humiliations have
increased?

Min Sin Jih Pao (明星日報), a mosquito paper, of May 30th.

PALATIAL CENTRAL POLICE STATION

Due to the large annual income of over $20,000,000,
the Shanghai Municipal Council is constructing palatial
buildings. The Council is now constructing a new
Central Police Station on Foochow Road, the site of which
occupies ten mow of land (the price of the land in this
area is very high). The building will be nine stories
high and the equipment of the building will be very up-
to-date. Lifts, bath rooms, and the latest sanitary
arrangements are provided. The new Central Police
Station will be the best equipped Police Station in the
Far East. Construction will be completed in 1935 and
the constructional fees and expenditure for electrical
and other equipment will be $1,000,000. The old and
worn out premises of the Bureau of Public Safety of the
Shanghai City Government will not bear comparison with
the new building.

1934年5月31日。下午译文。

小报《新中华》于1934年5月30日刊登了以下文章。

五卅惨案周年纪念

今天是五卅惨案周年纪念日。众所周知，惨案的发生是由于上海公共租界内帝国主义的压迫，但主要原因是日本帝国主义枪杀我国劳工。
惨案发生至今已数年。南京路上烈士的血迹早已消失，人们也已淡忘了这场惨案。但是，在中国的帝国主义势力却日益强大。继之而来的九一八事变和一二八事件给人民带来了悲痛。“打倒帝国主义”的口号已不再听到。这难道是国家耻辱增加的原因吗？

5月30日的小报《明星日报》。

宏伟的中央巡捕房

由于年收入超过2,000万元，上海工部局正在建造宏伟的建筑。工部局目前正在福州路建造一座新的中央巡捕房，占地十亩（该地区地价很高）。大楼高九层，设备非常现代化。配有电梯、浴室和最新的卫生设施。新的中央巡捕房将成为远东设备最好的巡捕房。工程将于1935年完工，建筑费及电气和其他设备费用为100万元。上海市政府公安局陈旧破败的旧址与新楼相比不可同日而语。

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

Agents A-2816, 3324 and 2486 report that local
communist adherents plan to commemorate the "May 30 Incident"
by the holding of 'flying' meetings and the surreptitious
dissemination of communist literature bearing on the occasion.
Their plans include the following :-
(1) The holding of a 'flying' meeting near the
junction of Robison and Ferry Roads between 6 and 7 p.m. May 29.
(2) The holding of a 'flying' meeting on Nanking Road
in the vicinity of Chekiang Road either between 2 and 4 p.m. or
between 6 and 8 p.m. on May 30. Members of various local
district committees have been instructed to participate. In
the event of police interference the venue will be changed to
Nanking Road near The Bund.
(3) The throwing of communist literature from the
roof gardens of the Wing On, Sincere and Sun Sun Coy's buildings
onto Nanking Road either during the heavy traffic hours or
during the evening of May 29.
(4) The despatching of groups of comrades to
disseminate communist literature in mill areas in the Eastern
and Western Districts either during the evening of May 29 or the
early hours of the morning of May 30.

participants will be confined to the shouting of slogans and
distribution of communist handbills.

on Nanking Road in the vicinity of Chekiang Road between 6 pm

previous report, further information indicates that the majority
of the participants will consist of industrial workers under
the leadership of the "Cotton Mill Workers' General Labour Union"
of the C.C.P. Demonstrators coming from the Western District
will gather in the vicinity of Thibet-Sinza Roads while those
coming from the Eastern District will meet near the Garden Bridge.

May 29, 1934.

"May 30" Anniversary - Kuomintang observance

The local Kuomintang has decided not to convene any
meeting in observance of the Anniversary of the Nanking
Road Incident which falls on May 30, nor will the Chinese
official organs, public bodies, educational institutions
and industrial concerns observe the occasion as a holiday.
The only form of commemoration will be the hoisting of
flags at half mast and the holding of a memorial service
at the "May 30th Martyrs Cemetery, West Paoshing Road,
Chapei, at 10 a.m. on that date.

SUMMARIZED TRANSLATION OF A COMMUNIST HANDBILL ENTITLED
"LETTER TO LABOUR, PEASANT AND TOILING MASSES IN CONNECTION
WITH THE MAY 30TH TRAGEDY".

To the toiling masses throughout the country,

To-day is the most glorious anniversary of the resistance
on the part of the Chinese people to foreign imperialists.

This tragedy arose through the brutal murder on May 14,
1925 of a worker of the Kung Dah No.5 Cotton Mill who had
demanded an increase of pay. The imperialists did not
content themselves with this incident but perpetrated more
tragic outrages, such as: the Shameen Incident, the Tsinan
Tragedy, the September 18 Embroglio, the Shanghai Incident
of January 28, etc. More recently they have been
contemplating a general massacre of the toiling masses
with the object of partitioning China.

The submission by the Kuomintang to foreign imperialism
has become more evident. Under the leadership of the
Chinese Communist Party, it is up to us to arm ourselves and
drive away the foreign imperialists, overthrow the traitorous
Kuomintang and establish a Soviet New China.

The Chinese Communist Party is now calling upon you
to undertake the following tasks:

1) Arm yourselves and revolt against the Kuomintang by
refusing to pay the taxes!

2) Oppose the joint control and partitioning of China by
the imperialists!

3) Oppose the attack by the imperialistic Kuomintang on the
Soviet Union, China's true friend!

4) Struggle for the independence of Soviet New China!

Shanghai Fah-Nan District Committee
of the
Chinese Communist Party.

May 25, 1934.

题为《致劳工、农民及劳苦大众关于五卅惨案的信》的共产党传单摘要译文。

致全国劳苦大众，

今天是中国人民反抗外国帝国主义最光荣的纪念日。

此次惨案起因于1925年5月14日，公大第五棉纱厂一名要求加薪的工人被残酷杀害。帝国主义分子并未就此罢休，而是制造了更多悲惨的暴行，例如：沙基惨案、济南惨案、九一八事变、一·二八上海事变等。近期，他们更图谋对劳苦大众进行大规模屠杀，旨在瓜分中国。

国民党屈服于外国帝国主义的行径已愈发明显。在中国共产党的领导下，我们必须武装起来，驱逐外国帝国主义，推翻卖国的国民党，建立苏维埃新中国。

中国共产党现在号召你们执行以下任务：

1) 武装起来，通过拒绝纳税来反抗国民党！

2) 反对帝国主义共同控制和瓜分中国！

3) 反对帝国主义国民党攻击中国的真正朋友苏联！

4) 为苏维埃新中国的独立而斗争！

中国共产党
上海法南区委员会。

1934年5月25日。

MASSES IN CONNECTION WITH THE MAY 30 ANNIVERSARY", DATED MAY 24,
1934, COPIES OF WHICH WERE FOUND BY THE MUNICIPAL POLICE
IN GORDON ROAD DISTRICT ON MAY 27, 1934.

To young labourers, peasants, students and other poor youths,

The May 30 Anniversary is again approaching. On May 15,
1925, Koo Tseng Hoong, a worker of the N.W.K. Cotton Mill in
Shanghai, was shot and killed by Japanese imperialists. On
May 30 the imperialistic British Police on Nanking Road and
at other places massacred a number of young labourers, students
and citizens who were delivering lectures in support of the
N.W.K. strike. Thus was the May 30 tragedy created. The
labourers and students in Shanghai, under the leadership of
the Chinese Communist Party, went on strike and were joined
by merchants who suspended their business. This was an
effective response to the atrocities of the Japanese and
British imperialists.

The anniversary of the May 30 incident this year finds
the Japanese imperialists intensifying their attacks in North
China, the British imperialists invading Thibet and Singkiang,
The French imperialists taking possession of nine islands in
South China and threatening Yunnan, Kweichow and Kwangse, and
the American imperialists constructing aerodromes and military
bases at Nanking, Hangchow and other places.

The political situation in China has reached a crisis.
As a result of a conference held at Nanchang, the national
traitors Chiang Kai Shek, Waung Tsing Wei and Huang Fu have
accepted all the demands submitted by Japan and the Chinese
troops stationed in North China have been transferred to attack
the Red Army of labourers and peasants. The traitors have
also adopted a system of White Terror to suppress the people's
anti-Imperialist and anti-Japanese movements.

Workers in the employ of Japanese cotton mills should
continue their struggles in the same spirit displayed in the
May 30 incident and declare strikes to oppose the oppression
at the hands of Japanese capitalists. B.A.T. workers should
unite and protest against the closing down of the Pootung
Factory and demand work. Juvenile workers should commemorate

标题为《致五卅纪念日青年群众书》的共产主义传单译文，日期为1934年5月24日，市政警察于1934年5月27日在戈登路地区查获该传单副本。

致青年工人、农民、学生及其他贫苦青年，

五卅纪念日再次临近。1925年5月15日，上海内外棉株式会社（N.W.K. Cotton Mill）工人顾正红（Koo Tseng Hoong）被日本帝国主义者枪杀。5月30日，帝国主义英国警察在南京路及其他地方屠杀了一批正在演讲以支持内外棉罢工的青年工人、学生和市民。五卅惨案由此酿成。上海的工人和学生在中国共产党领导下举行罢工，商人亦停业响应。这是对日本和英国帝国主义暴行的有效回应。

今年的五卅惨案纪念日正值日本帝国主义者加紧在华北进攻，英国帝国主义者入侵西藏和新疆，法国帝国主义者占据华南九岛并威胁云南、贵州和广西，以及美国帝国主义者在南京、杭州等地修建机场和军事基地之际。

中国政治局势已达危机时刻。由于南昌会议的结果，民族叛徒蒋介石、汪精卫和黄郛接受了日本提出的所有要求，驻扎在华北的中国军队被调去攻击工农红军。叛徒们还采取白色恐怖制度来镇压人民的反帝和抗日运动。

受雇于日本纱厂的工人应继续发扬五卅事件中展现的精神进行斗争，宣布罢工以反对日本资本家的压迫。英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）工人应团结起来，抗议浦东工厂关闭并要求工作。青年工人应纪念

Juvenile peasants should oppose the outrageous
taxation levied by the Kuomintang and the payment of taxes
and revenues. They should start a guerilla warfare and
participate in anti-Japanese movements in North China.
Students should commemorate the May 30 Anniversary

The following slogans should be used in commemoration

1) Declare a general strike and hold processions and

2) Oppose the attack on North China by White imperialists
and the capture of "Pang Hong" by British imperialists;
let the people arm themselves and drive away the
Japanese and British naval, military and air forces from
China!
3) Oppose the sale of North China by the Kuomintang; transfer
all troops throughout the country to North China to
fight the Japanese.
4) Overthrow the Japanese, British and other foreign
imperialists as well as their running dogs - the
Kuomintang.
5) Support the Soviet Red Army; annihilate the bandit
suppression campaign of the imperialistic Kuomintang!
6) Long live the independence and emancipation of the

学生应通过总罢工来纪念五卅纪念日，以反对国民党目前的奴化教育政策。此外，他们应组织抗日团体，要求言论、出版和集会自由。

3) 反对国民党出卖华北；调动全国所有军队赴华北抗击日本。

To the dear female labouring masses,

On May 30, 1926 (? 1925) the toiling masses
in Shanghai shed their blood and the workers of various
cotton mills declared a general strike to oppose the
oppression by the capitalists. Owing to the unity and
undaunted spirit of the workers, the capitalists began
to quiver and accepted the demands of the workers for
increase of wages and a reduction of working hours,
but the workers insisted on liberty and equality.

The anniversary of the May 30 Tragedy is fast
approaching. The labouring masses have to work long
hours at 3 day or 5 day shifts and endure oppression and
abuse. All the labourers are complaining of the
hardships and of the treachery and oppression of the
capitalists.

Labour friends, unite and observe the following
slogans:-

Oppose capitalists and overthrow the Japanese dwarfs!
Restore the former system of work and overthrow the
running dogs in factories.
Oppose the 3 day and 5 day shifts.
Oppose the deceit of capitalists and the dismissal of
workers.
Welcome the labouring masses and commemorate the May
30 Anniversary.
Support the Soviet Union. Long live the Soviet Union.

Propaganda Section of the Western
District Committee of the Chinese
Communist Party.

致亲爱的女工群众，

1926年（? 1925年）5月30日，上海的劳苦大众流血牺牲，各纱厂工人举行总罢工以反对资本家的压迫。由于工人的团结和大无畏精神，资本家开始颤抖，接受了工人增加工资和减少工时的要求，但工人坚持争取自由和平等。

五卅惨案纪念日迅速临近。劳苦大众不得不从事三班或五班制的长时间工作，忍受压迫和虐待。所有工人都在抱怨艰辛以及资本家的背叛和压迫。

劳工朋友们，团结起来并遵循以下标语：-

反对资本家，打倒日本矮子！
恢复以前的工作制度，打倒工厂里的走狗。
反对三班和五班制。
反对资本家的欺骗和解雇工人。
欢迎劳苦大众，纪念五卅周年。
支援苏联。苏联万岁。

Dear labour and poor masses,

"May 30" Anniversary - Kuomintang observance

The local Kuomintang has decided not to convene any
meeting in observance of the Anniversary of the Nanking
Road Incident which falls on May 30, nor will the Chinese
official organs, public bodies, educational institutions
and industrial concerns observe the occasion as a holiday.

The only form of commemoration will be the hoisting
of flags at half mast and the holding of a memorial service
at the "May 30th Martyrs Cemetery," West Paoshing Road,
Chapei, at 10 a.m. on that date.

COPY OF EXTRACT OF NEWSPAPER TRANSLATION OF MAY 29,1934.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

MAY 30TH INCIDENT ANNIVERSARY

Fearing that reactionary elements may create
disturbances on the anniversary of the May 30th Incident,
special precautionary measures will be adopted on that day
by both the military and police authorities of Chinese
controlled territory and the Foreign Settlements.

All unlawful meetings will be prohibited.
Armed police will be posted to search pedestrians at
important intersections and plainclothes police and
motor-cycle patrol corps will be on duty in the
Municipality.

May 30, 1934. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News (Editorial) :

ANNIVERSARY OF MAY 30TH INCIDENT

It is nine years since the May 30th Tragedy occurred. We feel very sad when we think of that year and our condition today; and we submit a few remarks on the occasion of the anniversary:

Since the industrial revolution in Europe, imperialist countries have become stronger and stronger and with a view to extending markets for their products, have invaded other countries. As a consequence, the two American Continents as well as Australia and Africa were divided among the imperialists. In the end, they sought markets in China. Following the Opium War of 1840 the Imperialists have become more oppressive towards China. In addition to bringing pressure to bear on China politically, the imperialists have employed economic means to oppress China. The demanding of indemnities, the appropriation of territory and the contracting of unequal treaties have followed. Inspite of the fact that rural China has become bankrupt and China's industries are in a deplorable condition as a result of their invasion, the imperialists have become more insolent towards China until the May 30th Tragedy occurred when an antagonistic attitude towards imperialists was assumed by the people of the country. Therefore, the May 30th Tragedy on one hand was an expose of the machinations of the imperialists and on the other hand was the awakening of the Chinese from slumber.

The causes of the May 30th Tragedy are as mentioned, therefore, the slogans employed are the abrogation of unequal treaties, the restoration of Customs autonomy, the withdrawal of foreign land and naval forces from China, the retrocession of leased territory and the cancellation of concessions and settlements. The effect of the anti-imperialist movement was far-reaching. In Shanghai alone, the number of students, workmen, and merchants on strike amounted to 300,000, an epoch making episode in the history of China. The anti-imperialist movement was followed by a strike in Canton and Hongkong of seamen lasting for a period of nineteen months. As a result, the truculent attitude of the imperialists towards China was modified and the Northern Military Expedition under the command of General Chiang Kai-shek succeeded. The May 30th Tragedy can be called an act of brutality of the imperialists as well as an awakening of China's national consciousness.

Although the Chinese people have not been slack in the movement against imperialists since the enactment of the May 30th Tragedy, the imperialists have continued to be aggressive towards China. The Mukden Incident of September 18th and the Pronouncement of April 17th are the manifestations of Japanese Imperialism. The situation of to-day is far more serious than that of nine years ago.

On the occasion of the Anniversary of the May 30th Tragedy, we should continue to show the spirit of that year in order to remove the national humiliations and save our race from extinction.

五卅惨案发生至今已九载。回首当年，审视今日之处境，吾人不胜悲戚；值此周年之际，谨陈数语：

自欧洲工业革命以来，帝国主义列强日益强盛，为拓展其产品市场，遂入侵他国。结果，美洲两大陆以及澳洲和非洲均被帝国主义者瓜分。最终，他们将目光投向中国市场。自1840年鸦片战争后，帝国主义者对中国的压迫愈加剧烈。除在政治上向中国施压外，帝国主义者还利用经济手段压迫中国。索取赔款、割占领土及签订不平等条约接踵而至。尽管因列强入侵导致中国农村破产、工业状况凄惨，但帝国主义者对华态度愈发傲慢，直至五卅惨案发生，举国百姓始对帝国主义者采取对抗态度。因此，五卅惨案一方面揭露了帝国主义者的阴谋诡计，另一方面也唤醒了沉睡中的中国人。

鉴于上述五卅惨案之起因，所提出的口号包括：废除不平等条约、恢复关税自主权、外国陆海军撤出中国、收回租借地以及取消租界与公租界。反帝运动影响深远。仅在上海一地，罢工的学生、工人和商人总数即达30万人，此乃中国历史上划时代之事件。继反帝运动之后，广州和香港的海员罢工持续了十九个月之久。结果，帝国主义者对中国的强硬态度有所缓和，蒋介石将军指挥的北伐得以成功。五卅惨案既可称为帝国主义者的暴行，亦可视为中国民族意识的觉醒。

虽然自五卅惨案发生以来，中国人民在反帝运动中从未懈怠，但帝国主义者仍继续对华采取侵略行径。九月十八日的沈阳事变（即九一八事变）及四月十七日的声明，即是日本帝国主义的表现。今日的局势比九年前更为严峻。

值此五卅惨案周年之际，我们应继续发扬当年的精神，以洗雪国耻，挽救民族于危亡。

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

Precautionary Measures On May 30 Anniversary Day

To-day is the 9th Anniversary of the
Nanking Road "May 30th Tragedy".
Fearing that the reactionary elements may
create trouble, the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander's
Headquarters, the Peace Preservation Corps, the Bureau
of Public Safety and the District Peace Protection Committ-:
have instructed their subordinate organs to adopt special
precautionary measures for one day. Police patrols,
detectives, and search parties will be on duty at the
various important sections of the district. In factory
zones, school areas and places near the Settlement boundary,
extra police will be on duty. Search parties will operate
on the streets, and illegal meetings and processions will
be prohibited. Similar precautionary measures will be
adopted in the Settlement and the Concession. The joint
precautionary measures for the month of May will be end
on the day after to-morrow.
No newspapers will be published and flags
will be flown at half-mast to-day.

The Board of Directors and Manifesto

The Board of Directors of the May 30th Martyrs
Cemetery will offer a sacrifice at 9 a.m. to-day. A
manifesto will be published, the gist of which is as
follows:-
"At 2 p.m. on May 30th nine years ago, a
great tragedy occurred on Nanking Road in front of Louza
Station. In memory of this tragedy, our Board hereby
observes this 9th Anniversary especially at the time when
the four North-Eastern Provinces are occupied by the
Japanese;
"The tragedy followed upon a dispute in a
Japanese Mill. Thirteen demands were made by the
Chinese Government, some of them were granted, and some of
them shelved. The following comments will be appropriate.
1. The abolition of the Mixed Court has been accomplished,
the integrity of a greater part of the Chinese judicial
rights has been preserved, and Chinese law students
are enabled to advance in their profession.
2. The addition of Chinese members to the S.M.C. has given
our people the opportunity to share in the administration
of the Settlement. However we will continue to strive
with a view to obtaining a greater share in the
Municipal Administration.
3. Although the construction of extra-Settlement roads
has ceased, the negotiations for the restoration of
the rights on the roads have been obstructed by the
Japanese.

五卅纪念日的预防措施

今日是南京路“五卅惨案”九周年纪念日。
因担心反动分子制造事端，吴淞上海警备司令部、保安队、公安局及各区保卫委员会
已指令其下属机构在一日内采取特别预防措施。警察巡逻队、侦探及搜查队将在本区各重要地段执勤。在工厂区、学校区域及靠近租界边界的地方，将增派警力。搜查队将在街道上行动，禁止非法集会和游行。租界及法租界也将采取类似的预防措施。五月份的联合预防措施将于后天结束。
今日所有报纸停刊，旗帜降半旗致哀。

理事会及宣言

五卅烈士公墓理事会将于今日上午9时举行祭奠仪式。并将发表宣言，其要点如下：
“九年前的5月30日下午2时，老闸捕房前的南京路上发生了一起重大惨案。为纪念此惨案，本理事会特此隆重纪念九周年，正值东北四省被日本占领之际；
“该惨案起因于一家日资纱厂的纠纷。中国政府提出了十三项要求，部分得到满足，部分被搁置。对此有以下评论可谓恰当。
1. 会审公廨的废除已经完成，中国大部分司法主权的完整性得以保留，中国法律系学生得以在职业上获得晋升。
2. 工部局董事会中增加华董，使我国人民有机会参与租界的行政管理。然而，我们将继续努力，以争取在市政管理中获得更大的份额。
3. 虽然越界筑路已停止，但关于收回道路权利的谈判受到日本的阻挠。
“工部局试图修订附则第34条，是引发五卅惨案的次要原因。去年，外国纳税人协会

May 30, 1934.
Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News:and other local newspapers:

Charge Against Yu Ya Ching.

The families of the victims of the May 30 Tragedy
some time ago found that Yu Ya Ching (虞洽卿), Zung Sih
Chun (成寰泰), Hu Zang Sung (胡嘉生) and Chen Poo Zah
(陳甫才) had embezzled the compassionate grants of $150,000
issued by the Shanghai Municipal Council in January 1930
to the families of the victims. Negotiations regarding
the case for the past several years have had no result.
Recently Yien Chun Ding (嚴春定), Chen Lih Tuh
(陳烈德), Hwa Tsoong Hai (華宗海), Chang Yoeh Tseu (張月秋)
and Tsai Dau Chun (蔡道春), families of the victims of
the May 30 Tragedy, retained lawyer Ma Chuin Shih (馬君碩)
and filed a charge in the 1st Special District Court,
requesting that the accounts kept by Yu Ya Ching for the
distribution of the compassionate grants be audited.
The case was dismissed by the Court. The families of the
victims have filed an appeal to the 2nd Kiangsu High Court.
On May 29 the families of the victims of the May
30 Tragedy called at the Shanghai City Government and
submitted the following appeal:-
Yien Tsoong Ping (嚴宗炳), son of Yien Chun Ding,
Hwa Tsoong Yuin (華宗元), elder brother of Hwa Tsoong Hai
and Chen Shing Fah (陳興發), younger brother of Chen Lih
Tuh lost their lives during the May 30 Tragedy, while Chang
Yoeh Tseu and Tsai Dau Chun were seriously wounded.
Despite the fact that several thousand dollars were
contributed by public bodies in the country and overseas
Chinese to relieve the families of the victims, yet the
latter have not received a single cent. In January 1930,
the S.M.C. handed to Yu Ya Ching, Zung Sih Chun and others
the compassionate grants of $150,000 for distribution to the
wounded martyrs as well as the families of the victims of
the May 30 Tragedy. Unexpectedly Yu Ya Ching and Zung
Sih Chun have submitted false accounts and illegally detained
these compassionate grants that should have been issued to
the families of the victims.
(1) Yu Ya Ching deducted $35,000 from the amount of the
compassionate grants to repay the money he had advanced.
What was the money advanced and how was it spent? When
did he advance the money and has he any proof to support
the claim that he had advanced it. The families of the
victims did not borrow a single cent from him and therefore
the statement of advancing money is a false report.
(2) Zung Sih Chun says that he paid $10,000 from the
amount of the compassionate grants to repay the loan contracted
for the construction of the May 30 Martyrs Cemetery and that
he paid in advance $10,000 for the construction of the same.
The Martyrs Cemetery was built as a token of respect to the
martyrs by the Government and the expenses for the Cemetery
should not be paid by the families of the martyrs. However,
Zung Sih Chun deducted the money from the compassionate
grants. Furthermore, no detailed accounts have been published
regarding the expenses of the Cemetery and Zung cannot produce
evidence that he had the expenses.

控告虞洽卿。

五卅惨案遇难者家属日前发现，虞洽卿、成寰泰 (Zung Sih Chun)、胡嘉生 (Hu Zang Sung) 和陈甫才 (Chen Poo Zah) 侵吞了上海工部局于1930年1月发给遇难者家属的15万元抚恤金。过去几年就此事进行的谈判均未取得结果。
近日，五卅惨案遇难者家属严春定 (Yien Chun Ding)、陈烈德 (Chen Lih Tuh)、华宗海 (Hwa Tsoong Hai)、张月秋 (Chang Yoeh Tseu) 和蔡道春 (Tsai Dau Chun) 聘请律师马君硕 (Ma Chuin Shih)，向第一特区地方法院提起诉讼，要求审计虞洽卿保管的抚恤金分发账目。
法院驳回了此案。遇难者家属已向江苏高等法院第二分院提起上诉。
5月29日，五卅惨案遇难者家属前往上海市政府，提交如下申诉：
严春定之子严宗炳 (Yien Tsoong Ping)、华宗海之兄华宗元 (Hwa Tsoong Yuin) 以及陈烈德之弟陈兴发 (Chen Shing Fah) 在五卅惨案中丧生，而张月秋和蔡道春则受重伤。
尽管国内外公共团体及华侨捐款数千美元以救济遇难者家属，但后者未收到分文。1930年1月，工部局将15万元抚恤金交给虞洽卿、成寰泰等人，用于分发给五卅惨案的受伤烈士及遇难者家属。不料虞洽卿和成寰泰提交虚假账目，非法扣留了本应发放给遇难者家属的抚恤金。
(1) 虞洽卿从抚恤金总额中扣除了3.5万元，以偿还其垫付款项。所谓垫付款项是什么？是如何花费的？他何时垫付的款项？是否有证据证明其确实垫付？遇难者家属未曾向他借过一分钱，因此所谓垫付款项的说法纯属虚报。
(2) 成寰泰称，他从抚恤金中支付了1万元，以偿还为建设五卅烈士公墓所借的贷款，并预先支付了1万元用于该公墓的建设。烈士公墓是政府为表达对烈士的敬意而建，公墓费用不应由烈士家属承担。然而，成寰泰却从抚恤金中扣除了这笔钱。此外，关于公墓费用的详细账目从未公布，成氏也无法提供其支付费用的证据。

(3) Yu Ya Ching says that he advanced $2,825 to meet the expenses of the May 30 Tragedy Martyrs Families Association. It will be remembered that the Association was first established in April 1929 in the Hwa Yuen Tea Shop (華園茶樓), West Gate, and later removed to the premises of the Min Jeu Primary School (敏求小學), West Gate. No rentals were paid for the above premises. There was only a secretary working for the Association. Expenditure incurred for sundry expenses were small and the sum Yu Ya Ching claimed to have advanced is exaggerated.
(4) Under the false name of the former Chamber of Commerce, Yu Ya Ching claims that he paid $1,710 advanced by the Chamber to meet the expenses of the families of the victims during the past years. This is simply a ruse of Yu Ya Ching, Zung Sih Chun and Hu Zang Sung and the families of the victims did not use a single cent. If it is true that Hu Zang Sung and Chen Poo Zah borrowed money, the money should be repaid by themselves and should not be deducted from the amount of the compassionate grants.
(5) There still remains $12,800 of the compassionate grants according to Yu Ya Ching himself. The interest on this remaining sum will have accumulated since 1930. However, Yu Ya Ching has not given the name of the bank in which the money is deposited. He kept the sum on the pretext that he feared there were still some more families of the victims who had not yet received grants. But there is no reason why these families would not come forward to receive their grants. Furthermore, the period of six months granted to the families of victims to submit claims has already expired and it is unreasonable that Yu Ya Ching should arbitrarily detain this remaining sum.
(6) According to the report of a chartered accountant, Chiang Hsin Chao (蔣信照), engaged by the "May 30th" Board of Directors, 55 grants were made to the wounded martyrs and the families of the deceased, and the sum distributed was $74,450. But if $2,000 was distributed to each family and $500 to each of the wounded, the total sum paid out was $6,300. What of the remaining $10,000?
(7) Apart from the misappropriation, the method of distribution of the grants by Yu Ya Ching was unjust. The family of Fu Yuan Pao (傅元豹) received a sum of $3,500 while the families of Yien Chun Ding and others obtained $2,000 each, less half per cent as tax. Hu Zang Sung and Chen Poo Zah, two of the wounded, who had special connection with Yu Ya Ching, received $5,000.
Chen Teh Mei (陳鐵梅) retained a lawyer to open negotiations with Yu Ya Ching and in consequence, he received an additional sum of $900, besides accepting the sum of $500, while Hoong Chun (洪春) and others received $500 only. Therefore, the injustice of Yu Ya Ching is obvious.
From the points mentioned, the misappropriation of "May 30th" compassionate grants by Yu Ya Ching and others is disclosed. Yien Chun Ding and other victims have opened negotiations with Yu Ya Ching, but without result. Recently, they retained a lawyer and instituted legal proceedings at the First Special District Court to investigate the accounts. (3) 虞洽卿称，他为垫付“五卅惨案”烈士家属协会的费用，垫款2,825美元。需指出的是，该协会最初于1929年4月在西门华园茶楼成立，后迁至西门敏求小学校舍。上述房址未支付租金。协会仅有一名秘书任职。杂项开支数额微小，虞洽卿声称的垫付款项实属夸大。
(4) 虞洽卿假借前商会之名，声称他支付了商会过去几年为垫付受害者家属费用而提供的1,710美元。这纯属虞洽卿、宗思俊（音译）和胡藏松（音译）的诡计，受害者家属分文未用。若胡藏松和陈宝斋（音译）借款属实，应由其自行偿还，不得从抚恤金中扣除。
(5) 据虞洽卿本人所述，抚恤金尚余12,800美元。自1930年以来，这笔余款的利息已累积。然而，虞洽卿并未说明款项存放的银行名称。他以担心仍有部分受害者家属尚未领取抚恤金为由扣留该款。但这些家属没有理由不前来领取。此外，给予受害者家属提交索赔申请的六个月期限早已届满，虞洽卿擅自扣留余款实属无理。
(6) 据“五卅”董事会聘请的注册会计师蒋信照的报告，向受伤烈士及死者家属发放了55笔抚恤金，分发总额为74,450美元。但若每户家庭分发2,000美元，每位伤者分发500美元，则支出总额仅为6,300美元。其余10,000美元去向如何？
(7) 除侵吞款项外，虞洽卿分发抚恤金的方式亦不公。傅元豹家属获发3,500美元，而严春鼎（音译）等人家属各获2,000美元，扣除百分之零点五的税款。胡藏松和陈宝斋两名与虞洽卿有特殊关系的伤者，各获5,000美元。
陈铁梅聘请律师与虞洽卿交涉，因此在接受500美元之外，又额外获得900美元，而洪春等人仅获500美元。因此，虞洽卿之不公显而易见。
综上所述，虞洽卿等人侵吞“五卅”抚恤金之事已暴露。严春鼎等受害者曾与虞洽卿交涉，但未果。近期，他们聘请律师，在第一特区地方法院提起诉讼以查账。应对方请求，章庆渊法官以……为由驳回了受害者的上诉。

May 29, 1934. Morning Translation

The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That the 36 tenants prosecuted by the landlords, and
the other tenants of the terrace attend the Court to-
day.
2. That evidence be collected in order to enable a charge
of false accusation to be filed against the landlords.
3. That the tenants unanimously oppose the new agreement.
4. That the Judge be requested to query the legal basis
of the landlords accusation.
5. That the unreasonable notices of the landlords be
presented at the Court.
6. That the Judge be requested to allow the tenants to
demand compensation from the landlords.
7. That the following notice be issued to all the tenants:-
"With reference to the accusation made by
the landlords, the tenants concerned are requested to
bring the rental receipts and present them at the Second
Special District Court at 2 p.m. to-day (May 29). The
other tenants who have been compelled by the landlords
to conclude the new agreement are also requested to
attend the hearing."
The local District Rent Reduction Committee,
the First Special District Citizens Federation and the
Second Special District Federation together with the
various branches will send their representatives to the
Court.

China Times and other local newspapers:
MEETING OF CHINESE DOCTORS ASSOCIATION
At a meeting held yesterday of the Shanghai
Chinese Medical Practitioners Association, a series of
resolutions were passed among which was one that warnings
be served on those members who insert untruthful adver-
tisements in the newspapers and that if the warnings
are ignored, the offending members be expelled from
membership of the Association.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:
MAY 30TH INCIDENT ANNIVERSARY.
Fearing that reactionary elements may create
disturbances on the anniversary of the May 30th Incident,
special precautionary measures will be adopted on that day
by both the military and police authorities of Chinese
controlled territory and the Foreign Settlements.
All unlawful meetings will be prohibited.
Armed police will be posted to search pedestrians at
important intersections and plainclothes police and motor-
cycle patrol corps will be on duty in the Municipality.
